A.case: Beam supported at both ends with the load centered over the span (worst case deflection)

B.case: Beam supported at both ends with the load evenly distributed over the span (worst case deflection)
B.note: W here is the total distributed load in pounds, as written in the catalog (L^3 * W form).

C.case: Beam fastened at one end and cantilevered horizontally with the load applied at the end of the beam (worst case deflection)

rules.rule: Profile cut-to-length tolerance (fractional): squareness +/- .002" per inch, length tolerance +/- .015"
Profile cut-to-length tolerance (metric): squareness +/- .02mm per cm, length tolerance +/- .38mm

Tap Profile End: designate the profile end (left, right, or both) that requires tap; each part number has a minimum thread depth (e.g. 15 Series 5/16-18 = 1.250", 3/8-16 = 1.500"; 10 Series 1/4-20 = 1.125")
Open style access holes and open style drill-thru/counterbores are specified by distance from the LEFT end of the profile plus a T-slot letter designation

Predetermined style access holes / drill-thru & counterbore are specified on left, right, or both ends; 15 Series first hole is .75" from end, then 2.25", 3.75", 5.25" (1.50" pitch); 10 Series .50", 1.50", 2.50", 3.50"; 40 Series 20, 60, 100, 140mm
Anchor fastener counterbore centerline is A from the profile end: 10 Series .406", 15 Series .855", 40 Series 19.99mm; counterbore centered across the face (B = .500" / .750" / 20.00mm)
Butt fastener counterbore centerline is A from the profile end: 10 Series .406", 15 Series .721", 40 Series 19.99mm

Anchor and butt fastener counterbores: designate profile end (left, right, or both) and the face letters (anchor fastener designations A-R); example (3) 1530 x 35.75 w/ #7040 at F, G, in Left End and at H in Right End
Anchor fasteners and butt fasteners require the counterbore machining service (pg. 10-7)
End fasteners: mounting profile requires end tap (pg. 10-3); mating profile requires access hole (pg. 10-5)
Central connector requires central connector profile milling when profile ends are captivated (pg. 10-20)

Profile miter cut: 0 to 75º, or 0 to 60º for select profiles (1530, 1545, 3030, 2040, 40-4080 families); 3060 and 40-8016 only 0-45º across/along the 6.00" (160mm) long side; angle refers to dimension A from square
Profile miter cut: designate the end (left, right, or both); a drawing is required with this machining service

Miter cut worksheet fields required for a custom profile miter cut: A and D (angles, positive/negative), B (length), C (profile dimension), E and F angles; example A = -30º, B = 43.18" or 450mm, C = 3.00" or 80mm, D = -45º, E = 45º, F = 60º. AutoQuoterX II always indicates material removed from the profile
Structural shape maximum miter angle is dependent on profile size
Miter Cut Counterbore: angles 30 to 60 degrees; service is for one end of profile, includes mounting hardware
Profile Miter Cut with Counterbore: 45º cut and counterbore on both ends with hardware, for custom lengths up to 72" (1828.8mm)
Clearance drill thru (in or between T-slots): designate T-slot position from left end of profile

Economy T-nut clearance slot: designate distance from profile end to slot centerline and T-slot; minimum end-to-slot-center distance C (15 Series single .601", double 1.538", triple 1.818"); tolerance slot length +/- .030", width +/- .010"
Handle milling services: designate distance from the end of profile to the handle centerline (CL)
45 degree flange milling (Quick Frame) is for both ends; if one end desired, specify left or right and include drawing
Panel cut-to-size tolerance +/- .060" (+/- 1.52mm); separate part numbers for ALL sides <= 48" vs ANY side > 48" and for up to .250" vs thicker
Panel clearance notches work with mesh, plastic panels, and aluminum up to .250" (6.35mm) thick; notch inside corner radius R .125" (3.18mm)
Panel/plate cutouts require a drawing
Top mount milling: panel or plate must be .250" (6mm) or thicker; hole location tolerance +/- .010"
Edge radius: min panel thickness .118" (3.00mm); full edge radius max .500", top edge radius max .750"
Stock profile lengths for 1515/1530 family: 120" and 242" (some profiles e.g. 1534-Lite, 3075 only 120"); metric 20 Series 3 or 6.050 meter
Packages longer than 95" must ship via commercial carrier; 95" or shorter can ship UPS (usually cheaper and faster)
Orders with 80/20 Builds services, custom machining, or totaling $10,000 or more have a scheduled lead time; order is ready for processing once all drawings, worksheets and payment are complete
